mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in payroll employment growth above 200k signals rising household income and consumer spending, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong payroll growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 6-month decline in the Housing Starts Index exceeding 10% signals weakening residential investment, which reduces GDP growth and drags S&P 500 returns lower over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of large HOUST declines (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month contraction in the Industrial Production Index below -2% signals slowing manufacturing activity, which reduces corporate earnings and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of INDPRO contraction (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a restrictive monetary stance that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of high FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 6-month decline in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures exceeding 3% signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate earnings and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of large RSAFS declines (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the unemployment rate below 3.5% signals a tight labor market that raises wage pressures and inflation expectations, which increases discount rates and reduces S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of very low UNRATE (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures above 2% signals strengthening aggregate demand, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong RSAFS growth (t-test p > 0.05).
